title: bot.ability.seeing.measure.completed
description: A measured view: the stimulus it came from, when it arrived, and the measurement.

visual.description: The measured stimulus, as it was when its measurement started.

image.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the image this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
image.title: Image

media_type.description: Optional media type for the image bytes, such as image/png or image/jpeg.
media_type.title: Media Type

kind.description: Optional low-cardinality visual provenance hint (for example camera, screen).
kind.title: Kind

source.description: Optional visual source: the transducer this view came off (a camera, a screen capture), as its emitter stamps it. The original carries it as the visual event's source; an SCXML event relayed through the body keeps only its data, so floppy carries it in the view [floppy field]. Seeing holds the newest view of each source and drops a view without one.
source.title: Source

participants.description: Who produced this stimulus, stamped by the device that emitted it. Empty when the device knows no one (ambient sound, an unattended camera).

items.description: Someone who took part in a stimulus: an opaque, producer-stable identity reference and the role it played (source: who produced it; target: who it was addressed to).

ref.description: Opaque, producer-stable identity such as a phone number, an app person id, or a chat handle. Never a display name chosen by the bot.
ref.title: Ref

role.description: source: who produced the stimulus (speaker, sender). target: who it was addressed to.
role.title: Role

own.description: True when the producer knows this participant is the bot itself, for example the bot's own voice heard back or the voice it spoke with. Stamped only by that producer; never inferred.
own.title: Own

resembles.description: For an identity its producer made just now (nobody it knew): the known identities it resembles, best first, at most 3. Stamped only by that producer; never a link.

items.description: A known identity this new one resembles: its ref and how similar the two are (-1..1). Perception data only: it links nothing, and it is never a print.

ref.description: The ref of the known identity, as its producer stamps it.
ref.title: Ref

similarity.description: How similar the two are, -1..1; higher is more alike.
similarity.title: Similarity

resembles.title: Resembles

items.title: Participant

participants.title: Participants

received_at.description: When the view arrived, on Seeing's clock, in milliseconds since the epoch (the original's timezone-aware datetime; floppy reads the session clock, Date.now()) [floppy field].
received_at.title: Received At

measurement.description: What the change measure answered: how much the view changed since the previous signature, and its own signature.

change.description: How much the view changed, 0 (same) to 1 (entirely different); null when there was no previous signature.
change.title: Change

signature.description: An opaque per-measure reference to a previously perceived view; never a product, prompt or telemetry value: a byte_identity signature carries its digest, a frame_diff signature its grid of values.

measure.description: Name of the measure that produced this signature; a measure compares only its own signatures.
measure.title: Measure

values.description: Finite numbers the measure compares, such as a downscaled grayscale grid.
values.title: Values

digest.description: A content digest the measure compares for equality, such as a SHA-256 hex digest.
digest.title: Digest

signature.title: Signature

measurement.title: Measurement
